integrity_notes: All finite base cases are exact rational, with an analytic Rayleigh/Green-kernel argument for the unbounded range; scientific novelty is conditional on the documented literature coverage. No external independent validation is represented.
scientific_limitations: Unit-conductance wheels with exactly two grounded noise-free leaders and relative Laplacian damping; not a result for weighted wheels, other noise models, other leader counts or arbitrary two-rim distance rankings at large size.
title: A six-rim-vertex transition in two-leader second-order wheel coherence
